subject: PROGRAM-ID paragraph
notes: Rule: 'A program contained within another program shall not be assigned the same name as that of any other program contained within the outermost program that contains this program' (--check 11.10.3 -> OK §11.10.3 3)). CheckDefinitionNameUniqueness part (2) flattens every outermost program's whole containment subtree (Containees, direct AND indirect) onto one OrdinalIgnoreCase set -> COBOL2214, not edition-gated. Probe probe dir out/probe/program-id-paragraph/sr3.cob -- SR3X nested inside SR3A AND a direct SR3X child of SR3OUT (the INDIRECT shape the golden does not cover) -> COBOL2214 at --std 85, 2002, 2023. The positive control (two different outermost programs each containing X) is pinned by unit TwoContainersMayEachContainOneName. The rule does not extend to a containee sharing the OUTERMOST program's own name (not 'contained within'), and the check correctly iterates only containees. || Editions (adjudicator, verbatim): 1985, 2002, 2014, 2023
